name: git-history
description: Git-history analysis topology — orchestrator + git-historian lead + 2 workers (history-collector, history-narrator). Two jobs: (1) tell a project's story from its branch/commit history, and (2) analyze effort allocation across one or more repos on a single timeline. A deterministic collector script (scripts/collect.py) extracts effort proxies (commits, line churn, time-clustered work hours, per-area attribution) and narrative signals (commit-message keywords, structural shifts, stack/dependency changes, reverts, gaps) into datapack.json; scripts/render.py draws PNG charts (matplotlib); the history-narrator turns the facts into prose + a structured report, clearly separating evidence from inference. Path-lock keyed to git-history-report/**. Standalone. Requires common@alegomes.
